description: Surveys Branch. Churchill [map]. 1:5,400. [Winnipeg]: Manitoba Department of Mines and Natural Resources, 1932. This map shows the townsite of Churchill as proposed in 1932, three years after the railroad reached the port. The harbour facilities are clearly depicted, in this the only ocean port in Manitoba.
